Retrograde — Cursed Technique Reversal

You have learned the reversal of your technique. Rather than reversing what was, you reinforce what will happen as a certainty. As an action for 6 CE, you target a creature within 30 ft that you can see and declare their defeat/victory to be certain. For 1 minute, they are under the effects of Certain Defeat or Certain Victory. You can only have a declaration against one creature at a time.

Certain Defeat. A creature under your declaration cannot gain advantage and is unaffected by any effects that would cause it to reroll dice (including Retrograde). The first time the creature takes damage or fails a saving throw each round, they take a number of d10s in necrotic damage equal to your proficiency bonus and can only take this damage once per round.

Certain Victory. A creature under your declaration cannot gain disadvantage. Additionally, when they have advantage on a roll they instead roll 3 dice and take their pick as victory guides their hand. If using Certain Victory on yourself, you can only use Retrograde features on other creatures.
